main_measure.name: t of the pooled OLS slope of excess 10-bar forward return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm: t >= 2 with top-minus-bottom quintile > 0; reject: t <= -2; else inconclusive

supporting_check.name: top minus bottom forecast quintile mean excess 10-bar return

decided_by: Confirm rule met: slope t is 2 or more and the top-minus-bottom quintile difference is above 0.
reading: Grid at positions 0,10,20,... of each window with forward return close[t+10]/close[t]-1 inside the window; excess over each coin's mean grid 10-bar return across all its windows; quintiles are of the pooled grid forecasts (ties broken by order).
